description: 下水道管路延長状況(2023年11月30日更新) [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊田市. 豊田市の下水道管路（公共下水道（汚水・雨水）、農業集落排水、地域下水道）の延長状況に関するデータです。. Coverage: 豊田市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊田市. Its tags are 上下水道. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-07-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
